The '''Bounty Supply Company''' was a premier supplier of weapons, transportation and armor for [[Bounty hunter/Legends|enforcement contractors]] during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Their unique deals for equipment were said to be always eagerly anticipated by consumers.
